content.short: OADA is an ADA derivative system by Optim Finance providing yield aggregation and DeFi composability.
content.description: OADA is an advanced staking derivative protocol on Cardano that enhances the utility of staked ADA. The protocol allows users to mint oADA, a liquid representation of their staked assets, enabling them to participate in DeFi while still earning staking rewards. By solving the capital inefficiency of traditional staking, OADA provides a flexible tool for yield optimization and liquidity management. It plays a crucial role in the Cardano DeFi ecosystem by bridging secure network participation with active financial strategies.
